bullets.text: Russian bombing has reportedly killed 24 people at a Ukrainian aid centre, with local officials stating that at least nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit a village in southern Ukraine.
The Sudanese diaspora and human rights groups have criticized the UAE's nominee for a top UN job, citing her denial of accusations that the UAE is fueling the Sudan war.
Canada and the EU have announced a new 'Alliance for the Future', open to other like-minded countries, conceived for a world facing new challenges.
Australia's world-first social media ban for users under 16 will face its first major legal challenge in the High Court today, nearly a year after taking effect.
Residents living near the new Western Sydney International Airport are campaigning for a curfew due to noise concerns, as its October opening raises fears for the future of their tranquil suburbs.
The Reserve Bank is widely expected to increase interest rates today, with warnings that such a hike could push Australia into a recession.
A large majority of US voters disapprove of Donald Trump's handling of inflation, with affordability issues topping concerns ahead of the midterm elections.
Alphabet Inc. successfully raised ",6 billion in its second euro bond sale this year, offering higher yields than in May amid concerns about the pace of AI spending.
The incoming ECB chief faces a challenging environment as Christine Lagarde departs, while global oil markets remain volatile with Brent crude near its Iran-war peak.
